Final Project.title: Air Quality Monitoring System (IoT & Machine Learning)
Final Project.description: Designed and implemented a modular backend system for real-time air quality forecasting. Integrates a Laravel database backend with a Flask machine learning microservice predicting AQI via the Prophet model. Formulated a 4-layer architecture (Device, Service, Data, Presentation) validated under load. This system served as the basis for a peer-reviewed research paper published in IEEE ICoDSA 2025.
advisor: Dr. Hanif Fakhrurroja, S.Si, M. T.

Group.title: AI & ML based Health Diagnosis System
Group.description: Collaborated in a team of 6 to build an AI/ML health diagnosis system predicting Alzheimer's, pneumonia, and fetal health. Developed backend API services and frontend interfaces, integrating machine learning models with a conversational AI interface. Solved user trust and analysis bottlenecks for diagnostic screening.

Group.title: Horticultural Production Forecasting Dashboard
Group.description: Developed a predictive forecasting dashboard to model and visualize agricultural production metrics. Built using React and Node.js with MongoDB to ingest historical production datasets, providing predictive insights and enabling optimized resource allocation.

Solo.title: Campkit (Camping E-Commerce & Booking)
Solo.description: An e-commerce and booking platform for campers to find and rent high-quality camping equipment. Built as a solo project, implementing full-stack features including product catalogs, cart logic, and PostgreSQL database queries.

Solo.title: Gamepad Calibration Dashboard
Solo.description: Developed a sleek, modern dashboard for monitoring gamepad controller inputs and configuring profile settings. Focuses on minimal load times, high-framerate input tracking, and responsive layout styling.

Solo.title: Custom Planning & Resource Management System
Solo.description: Engineered a comprehensive planning and budgeting system for managing complex event logistics. Implemented advanced data filtering, budget calculations, task tracking, and resource management models using Excel and Google Sheets to resolve operational constraints.

Solo.title: Next.js Camera Photobooth
Solo.description: Developed a web application that interacts with device cameras to capture photos, apply dynamic image filters, and handle image downloads. Built using Next.js and React to ensure optimal performance.

Solo.title: Command Line Task Manager
Solo.description: Built a Python-based task management utility utilizing structured object-oriented programming to handle task priority, storage persistence, and task scheduling.
